diagnosis: invalidate_contract_cache accepts contract_id and executes cacheops invalidate_obj on the resolved EnterpriseContract. Because the view fails to ensure that the contract belongs to request.user.organization, an attacker can purge cached database querysets across competing tenants, inducing cache stampedes and database denial-of-service.
